info.title: imbrace-workflows
info.description: Imbrace workflow APIs exported for AI-agent tool use. Curated subset matching the Imbrace SDK. Import a subset with ?tags=… — available tags: flows, triggers, runs, folders, connections, pieces, tables, fields, mcp-servers, invitations.

post.summary: Apply an operation to a flow (e.g. UPDATE_TRIGGER, ADD_ACTION)
Trigger a flow and wait for the result

get.summary: Get a flow run by id

items.description: App connection is a connection to an external app.

post.summary: Create or update an app connection

get.summary: Get a piece's full metadata — its actions & triggers and, for each, the field/prop schema (name, type, required, static options) needed to configure a step

post.summary: Resolve the live options for a DYNAMIC property (dropdown that depends on a connection or other fields). Requires an existing flow/step context.

actionOrTriggerName.description: the action/trigger the property belongs to

propertyName.description: the dynamic property to resolve options for

input.description: current values of the other props (dependencies of the dynamic property)

searchValue.description: optional search filter for the options

post.summary: Create one or more table records

records.description: Array of records; each is an array of { fieldId, value } cells

delete.summary: ⚠️ DESTRUCTIVE — Delete table records by id

get.summary: Get a table record by id

cells.description: Array of { fieldId, value } cells to set

get.summary: Get an MCP server by id
